name: Career Development Events (CDEs)

objectives.text: Identify examples of FFA Career Development Events and the agricultural skills each one tests
Describe how CDEs advance from the chapter level to district, state, and national competition
Explain the purpose of Career Development Events and Leadership Development Events and how the two differ
Demonstrate the sportsmanship, honesty, and conduct expected of FFA members during competitive events
Select a CDE that fits a personal agricultural interest or SAE and explain the reasons for the choice
Interpret the rules, event format, and scoring components of a chosen CDE using the official event handbook
Practice the core skills of a chosen CDE such as identification, placing classes, or practicums under timed conditions
Explain how participation in CDEs builds leadership, citizenship, and career skills in FFA members
Justify placings in a judging class by delivering organized oral reasons with accurate industry terminology
Apply a team strategy and division of roles to prepare a team for a CDE
Analyze CDE scorecards and past results to identify personal strengths and areas needing improvement
Plan a practice schedule that prepares a team for a state-level CDE within available time and resources
Analyze how the skills tested in a CDE match the tasks performed in a related AFNR career
Evaluate team performance in a CDE using results and judge feedback and recommend improvements for the next competition cycle
Design a mock contest or training activity that prepares younger chapter members for a CDE

changes:
I kept all six original competencies and reworded them for clarity. Grade 4 now names the skills each event tests, and grade 6 adds how CDEs and LDEs differ. Grade 8 now gives concrete practice formats.

I added nine objectives that cover distinct CDE sub-skills:
- the chapter-to-national progression
- sportsmanship and ethical conduct
- choosing an event that fits an interest or SAE
- interpreting the event handbook and scoring
- delivering oral reasons
- explaining how CDEs build leadership
- analyzing scorecards
- linking CDE skills to AFNR careers
- designing training for younger members

I attached AFNR codes only where the fit is direct: FPS.14.04.01.b, CRP.12.02, ECL.02.03.01.b and CRP.06.03.02.c. Objectives below grade 9 have no codes. General career preparation is left to the sibling sub-topic Career Readiness & Networking.
